name: Bridge Prep: Xi Cross-Shell Correlation Measure

pytorch.reason: load_bearing: Xi computed as Frobenius inner product <A,B>_F / (||A||_F * ||B||_F) using torch tensors; also cosine similarity on flattened generators

pyg.reason: not needed -- no graph-native dynamics in this correlation measure

z3.reason: load_bearing: UNSAT proof that Xi(A,B) > Xi(A,A) for distinct shells is impossible (no shell can be more correlated with another than with itself; Xi <= 1)

cvc5.reason: not needed -- z3 covers the UNSAT bound; cvc5 crosscheck deferred to canonical upgrade

sympy.reason: load_bearing: symbolic projection of u(3) generator onto so(3) shows the real antisymmetric part IS the so(3) generator; Xi = fraction of generator surviving the projection

clifford.reason: load_bearing: Xi in Cl(3,0) as scalar part of A†B; adjacent shells share more Clifford grade structure than non-adjacent

geomstats.reason: not needed -- Riemannian geodesics are a canonical-level extension of Xi; this baseline uses Frobenius inner product

e3nn.reason: not needed -- equivariant neural layers not required at classical baseline

rustworkx.reason: load_bearing: Xi graph with G-tower shells as nodes and Xi values as edge weights; verify edge weight decreases with tower distance

xgi.reason: not needed -- no multi-way hyperedge structure required for pairwise Xi

toponetx.reason: not needed -- no cell-complex topology at baseline level

gudhi.reason: load_bearing: Vietoris-Rips on 6-shell generator feature vectors; edge appears at radius = 1 - Xi (closer = more correlated); H0 connected component count as function of filtration radius

P1_xi_so3_u3_positive.note: SO(3)→U(3) complexification: real antisymmetric part of u(3) IS so(3)

P2_xi_u3_su3_positive.note: U(3)→SU(3): traceless part of u(3) generator IS su(3) generator

P3_xi_gl3_sp6_less_than_adjacent.note: GL(3) and Sp(6) are non-adjacent; their Xi should not exceed adjacent-pair Xi

P4_xi_symmetric.note: Xi(A,B) = Xi(B,A) -- Frobenius inner product is symmetric

P5_xi_self_correlation_is_one.note: Xi(A,A) = 1: a shell is maximally correlated with itself

P6_adjacent_xi_exceeds_nonadjacent.note: Average Xi for adjacent tower pairs >= average for non-adjacent

P7_xi_decreases_with_tower_distance.note: Xi(SO3, O3) >= Xi(SO3, Sp6): nearer tower neighbor has higher correlation

P8_frobenius_inner_product_xi_proxy.note: Best Frobenius inner product between any so(3) gen and real antisym part of any u(3) gen > 0

N1_z3_unsat_xi_exceeds_self_correlation.note: UNSAT: Xi(A,B) > Xi(A,A)=1 impossible; Cauchy-Schwarz bounds Xi <= 1

N2_self_xi_is_one_distinct_is_less.note: Xi(A,A)=1 and Xi(A,B)<=1 for distinct shells

N3_sympy_u3_projects_onto_so3.note: Sympy: real antisymmetric part of u(3) generator IS the so(3) generator (fraction=1)

N4_clifford_adjacent_shares_more_grade.note: Clifford grade inner product: SO3-U3 share more grade structure than SO3-Sp6

N5_xi_nonself_bounded_by_one.note: Xi is always bounded by 1.0 (Cauchy-Schwarz); Xi(GL3,O3) and Xi(GL3,Sp6) both <= 1

N6_rustworkx_xi_graph_adjacent_outweighs.note: Xi graph has 6 nodes; adjacent edges outweigh distance-2 edges on average

B1_so3_embedded_in_u3_xi_is_maximal.note: At SO(3)→U(3) embedding, real antisymmetric overlap Xi is large (> 0.5)

B2_gudhi_rips_h0_all_connected_at_large_.note: Vietoris-Rips on Xi-distance matrix: H0=1 means all shells connected

B3_xi_symmetric_all_pairs.note: Xi(A,B) = Xi(B,A) verified for all 30 ordered pairs

B4_xi_at_embedding_point_well_defined.note: Xi at the SO(3) embedding in U(3) is well-defined and positive

B5_xi_diagonal_all_ones.note: Xi(A,A) = 1.0 for all six shells in the G-tower
